acceptance.note: Designed by Kane CLI's assurance commands from the user's request(s) in the agent session; run as written, never reviewed or promoted to trusted.
requests: Add a cookie consent banner to the CloudScale dashboard (app/app/). It should appear for first-time visitors with 'Accept' and 'Decline' buttons, remember the choice in localStorage, and fit the existing CloudScale styling. Keep it in a new component.

t-2.title: Accept consent is saved and first-time prompt stays away
t-2.summary: A first-time dashboard visitor selects Accept, the accepted choice is retained in localStorage, and the first-time banner does not recur on a subsequent visit.

t-1.title: Decline consent is saved and first-time prompt stays away
t-1.summary: A first-time dashboard visitor selects Decline, the declined choice is retained in localStorage, and the first-time banner does not recur on a subsequent visit.
